SELECT AdjustmentMethod, CurrencyIsoCode, Description, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, IsActive, Name, Pricebook2Id, ScheduleType FROM PriceAdjustmentSchedule WHERE ContractId = NULL ORDER BY Name ASC, Pricebook2.Name ASC
objects.$comment: ONE schedule per type, in the corporate currency (USD), as in qb-pricing. Upsert on Name, not Update: a 264 org seeds only the Attribute, Bundle and Price Adjustment Tier schedules, so 'Standard Tier Based Adjustment' and 'Standard Volume Based Adjustment' must be created here, and an Update left their tiers with no parent (measured on a fresh 264 q3 build, todo 319). Ordered before the child adjustments so each schedule exists first. The two volume schedules load IsActive=false: the platform rejects any PriceAdjustmentTier write while its schedule is active (#656).

objects.query: SELECT AdjustmentType, CurrencyIsoCode, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, LowerBound, PriceAdjustmentScheduleId, PricingTerm, PricingTermUnit, Product2Id, ProductSellingModelId, ScheduleType, SellingModelType, TierType, TierValue, UpperBound, PriceAdjustmentSchedule.Name, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name, ProductSellingModel.SellingModelType FROM PriceAdjustmentTier ORDER BY PriceAdjustmentSchedule.Name ASC, Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC, TierType ASC
SELECT Name FROM AttributeBasedAdjRule ORDER BY Name ASC

SELECT AttributeBasedAdjRuleId, AttributeDefinitionId, BooleanValue, DateValue, DateTimeValue, DoubleValue, IntegerValue, Operator, ProductId, StringValue, AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name, AttributeDefinition.Code, Product.StockKeepingUnit FROM AttributeAdjustmentCondition ORDER BY AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name ASC, AttributeDefinition.Code ASC, Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC

SELECT AdjustmentType, AdjustmentValue, AttributeAdjConditionsHash, AttributeBasedAdjRuleId, AttributeCount, CurrencyIsoCode, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, PriceAdjustmentScheduleId, PricingTerm, PricingTermUnit, ProductId, ProductSellingModelId, ScheduleType, SellingModelType, AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name, PriceAdjustmentSchedule.Name, Product.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name FROM AttributeBasedAdjustment ORDER BY AttributeBasedAdjRule.Name ASC, PriceAdjustmentSchedule.Name ASC, Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode DESC

SELECT AdjustmentType, AdjustmentValue, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, Name, PriceAdjustmentScheduleId, ProductId, ParentProductId, RootBundleId, ProductSellingModelId, ParentProductSellingModelId, PricingTerm, PricingTermUnit, RootProductSellingModelId, ScheduleType, SellingModelType, CurrencyIsoCode, PriceAdjustmentSchedule.Name, Product.StockKeepingUnit, ParentProduct.StockKeepingUnit, RootBundle.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name, ParentProductSellingModel.Name, RootProductSellingModel.Name FROM BundleBasedAdjustment ORDER BY PriceAdjustmentSchedule.Name ASC, Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode DESC

SELECT Name, IsActive, IsDerived, Pricebook2Id, Product2Id, ProductSellingModelId, UnitPrice, CurrencyIsoCode, Pricebook2.Name, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name FROM PricebookEntry WHERE Pricebook2.IsStandard = true ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, Pricebook2.Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode DESC, Name ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC
objects.$comment: Pass 1 loads the Standard Price Book entries only; pass 2 loads the Nonprofit book. The platform rejects a custom-book entry whose Standard entry doesn't exist yet (STANDARD_PRICE_NOT_DEFINED), and in one batch it doesn't (measured on a fresh 264 q3 build: all 60 Nonprofit rows, todo 319). The externalId carries Pricebook2.Name, because the same SKU, selling model and currency is in both books; the WHERE scopes the target query to the pass's book and sourceRecordsFilter selects the CSV rows (SFDMU applies a WHERE to the target only).

objects.query: SELECT PricebookId, PricebookEntryId, ProductId, ContributingProductId, ProductSellingModelId, DerivedPricingScope, Formula, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, PricingSource, CurrencyIsoCode, Pricebook.Name, PricebookEntry.Product2.StockKeepingUnit, PricebookEntry.ProductSellingModel.Name, Product.StockKeepingUnit, ContributingProduct.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name FROM PricebookEntryDerivedPrice ORDER BY Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ContributingProduct.StockKeepingUnit ASC, Pricebook.Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode DESC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC

SELECT Cost, CostBookId, CostBook.Name, CostBook.IsDefault, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, ProductId, Product.StockKeepingUnit, Description, CurrencyIsoCode FROM CostBookEntry ORDER BY CostBook.Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode DESC, Name ASC

The Nonprofit book's entries, after pass 1 created their Standard entries. Same key, root CSV and columns as pass 1; the WHERE and sourceRecordsFilter select the other book.
